/* com.shop.mapper.partner.selectPartnerListPaging */ SELECT COUNT(1) OVER() AS totalRowCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY TP.ID ASC) AS no, TP.ID AS id, TP.PARTNER_TICKER , TP.PARTNER_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE('10060', TP.PARTNER_TYPE) PARTNER_TYPE_NM, TP.PARTNER_NM, TP.PARTNER_SUB_NM, TP.LOCATION AS location , TP.ETC_INFO AS etcInfo, TP.SUB_DOMAIN AS subDomain, TP.PHONE_NO, TP.REP_NM, TP.EMAIL, TP.CRE_TM AS creTm, TP.CRE_USER AS creUser, FN_GET_USERNAME(TP.CRE_USER) as creUserNm, TP.UPD_TM AS updTm, TP.UPD_USER AS updUser, TP.FIRST_GREETING_MESSAGE , TP.REVIEW_POINT_RATE AS reviewPointRate, TP.SIZE_INFO AS sizeInfo, FN_GET_USERNAME(TP.UPD_USER) as upduserNm FROM TB_PARTNER AS TP WHERE TP.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND TP.PARTNER_NM LIKE '%' || #{filter.partnerNm} || '%'
AND TP.CRE_TM BETWEEN #{filter.startDate} AND #{filter.endDate} + INTERVAL '1 day'
ORDER BY TP.ID DESC OFFSET ((#{curPage}-1) * #{pageRowCount}) ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageRowCount} ROWS ONLY
